name: yaait
description: Yet Another AI Thing — a development methodology in six commands (spec, design, tech, code, stest, debt) for building software with an LLM without accumulating debt nobody can pay. An unattended LLM is a technical-debt reactor; yaait gates the person rather than the artifact: it challenges you, teaches you enough to challenge it back, and lets nothing pass until you can defend it or the record says you could not.
